documents: Export Declaration Form (Axis Annexure 6 / RBI Annex PDF)

signing.note: Signed by authorized official with company stamp. Scanned copy or digitally signed EDF (DSC) accepted per Axis AEXIM policy.

channels.title: Axis Bank NEO for Corporates
steps: Log in to Axis Bank NEO for Corporates.
Navigate to Trade Finance / TF Connect.
Submit export transaction documents and attach the signed EDF PDF.
Confirm digital filing workflow with your branch or RM.

channels.title: Email to Branch or Relationship Manager
steps: Open the email draft to your Axis Bank branch or Relationship Manager.
Attach the scanned/signed EDF PDF (or DSC-signed EDF), the XLSX spreadsheet, and invoice copies.
Send before {dueDate} and request a submission acknowledgement.
Save the bank's written acknowledgement and upload it back to Korra.

channels.title: Axis Bank Branch Trade Desk
steps: Print the signed EDF (Annexure 6) and customer request letter on company letterhead.
Affix company stamp and authorized signatory signature.
Submit at the Trade Desk of your Axis Bank branch before {dueDate}.
Collect the stamped acknowledgement copy and upload it to Korra.

email.subject: EDF Submission - {month} - Axis Bank (AD Code: {adCode})
email.intro: Please find attached our Export Declaration Form (EDF) and supporting export invoice documents for {month} under FEMA 23(R).
